A '''Unidentified [[DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droid/Legends|DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droid]]''', also known as '''Sith probe droid''', was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] employed by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
[[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] carried three DRK-1 probe droids aboard the [[Scimitar/Legends|''Scimitar'']] during his time as the apprentice of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. Maul recreated these spherical robots using the most disparate, off-the-shelf pieces. He also used his probots to track down [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] struck down one of the spying probes. This droid was the lucky one, which found the Jedi on Mos Epsa and informed Maul about his location.
